name: Disorder

features.name: Fire Frames
features.description: Split any symbol that lands inside them.

features.name: Variable bonus length
features.description: Bonus and super bonus symbols set the spin count.

review:
Six reels on a 4-3-4-3-4-3 layout. Fire Frames appear at random and split any symbol landing in them, and Enhancer Cells at the bottom of reels 2, 4 and 6 switch on depending on how many Fire Frames land.

Infectious xWays and xBomb push the ways up even more. In the bonus, bonus symbols add +2 spins and super bonus symbols +3, leading to Obsessive Compulsive Spins. Extreme volatility, 23,500x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
